name: spiral-book
description: Spiral-bound books from Markdown: scaffold a project (color-coded sections, thumb index tabs), pandoc → Typst → PDF, then a 2-up imposed print-ready PDF; every write is contained to the one project directory the operator names
hits: the local filesystem (one book project directory)
surface: CLI + a Claude Code skill that routes through it. `check`/`plan`/`build`/`impose` are reads (build and impose regenerate derived files inside the named project); `scaffold` is containment-gated (creates files only under the named dir, refuses to touch existing ones, `--force` replaces template files and still never a chapter); `clean` deletes generated files only with `--yes`. Nothing reaches the network or a credential.

origin.note: the source is one SKILL.md with the pipeline scripts embedded as code blocks; here they are extracted into templates/ and driven by spiral-book.mjs so the doctor, tests and smoke test have something to run. The skill text is the vendored copy in skill/SKILL.md, rewritten to route through the CLI and to treat cover art as optional and external (the original pointed at a local image-generation project that is not part of this tool).

install.description: Create the in-project .venv with pypdf (the imposition library)
install.why: impose and the last step of build import pypdf; a poetry env keeps it out of the system Python (SENSIBILITIES #10)
install.yes: tools/spiral-book/.venv/ is created from poetry.lock; nothing outside this directory changes
install.no: skipped; build still produces the book PDF and reports imposition as degraded until you run it

install.description: Install the spiral-book skill where Claude Code discovers it
install.why: the skill is the conversational front door (gather title/sections/chapters, then call this CLI); without the link Claude Code does not see it
install.yes: ~/.claude/skills/spiral-book becomes a link to this tool's skill/ dir; a real directory already there is renamed to spiral-book.pre-toolbelt, never deleted
install.no: nothing changes; any existing ~/.claude/skills/spiral-book keeps working on its own, unlinked from the belt

env.name: SPIRAL_BOOK_PYTHON
env.description: Interpreter that can `import pypdf`, used by impose and the last build step. Default: this directory's .venv/bin/python. The scaffolded build.sh honors the same variable

auth.flow: none — local files under a directory the operator names; no credential exists and nothing reaches the network

verbs.name: check
verbs.note: pandoc / typst / pypdf / fswatch presence and versions with brew/poetry fix lines; exit 1 when a required one is missing

verbs.name: plan
verbs.note: chapters from the project's build.sh, which are written vs placeholder, which outputs exist

verbs.name: scaffold
verbs.note: creates guide/{template/theme.typ,template/layout.typ,main.typ,build.sh,impose.py,NN-*.md} and .gitignore under the ONE directory named; every path is checked against that root (contained() in spiral-book.mjs); refuses when any target exists; --force replaces template/build files and never a chapter .md; --explain lists the plan

verbs.name: build
verbs.note: pandoc each chapter to guide/NN-*.md.typ, typst compile to guide/<slug>.pdf, then impose; writes only those derived files inside the named project and never a chapter .md; without pypdf it names the degraded mode and still exits 0

verbs.name: impose
verbs.note: guide/<slug>.pdf → guide/<slug>-print-ready.pdf inside the named project; half-letter pages only, other sizes are refused by impose.py

verbs.name: clean
verbs.note: deletes the generated .md.typ and PDFs of the named project; previews and writes nothing without --yes (exit 2 headless, 0 at a terminal); chapter and template files are never in the list

verbs.name: watch
verbs.note: no belt verb; the scaffolded build.sh has a `watch` mode (fswatch + typst watch) the operator runs in their own terminal

verbs.name: cover art generation
verbs.note: the skill drafts a text prompt into guide/cover-prompt.txt; generating the image is outside this tool (any generator, a designer); main.typ ships with the cover block commented out

safeguards: Containment: resolveProject() fixes the root once and contained() in spiral-book.mjs rejects any write path not under it; chapter stems are validated against STEM_RE (NN-slug, lowercase, no separators) at parse time so no flag can name a path outside the project (SENSIBILITIES #2)

scaffold never overwrites: with any target present it exits 2 naming the files; --force replaces only the generated template/build files and skips every chapter .md; .md files the operator wrote survive every re-run
build and impose write only derived files (guide/NN-*.md.typ, guide/<slug>.pdf, guide/<slug>-print-ready.pdf) inside the named project; chapter sources are read, never written

clean is a flag-gated delete: without --yes it lists exactly the files and writes nothing (exit 2 with no terminal so an agent cannot mistake the preview for success); the list is computed from the project's own build.sh and never includes a chapter or template file (SENSIBILITIES #2)
--explain on scaffold, build, impose and clean prints the plan and touches nothing (SENSIBILITIES #5)

Ceilings are code constants in spiral-book.mjs: MAX_CHAPTERS=40 (refused, not lowered), PALETTE of 6 section colors, 8-character tab labels, STEP_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 per pandoc/typst invocation with no retry (SENSIBILITIES #3)
An audit line goes to stderr on every scaffold, build, impose and clean: timestamp, verb, target dir, file delta (SENSIBILITIES #7)

Degraded mode is named: a missing pypdf makes build skip imposition and say so with the poetry fix; a missing pandoc or typst is exit 1 with the brew fix before anything is written (SENSIBILITIES #8, #10)
No credential, no network: auth.principal is none; the only env var is the path of a Python interpreter (SENSIBILITIES #11, #13)

checks.label: fswatch installed (optional: watch mode in a scaffolded build.sh)

checks.fix: cd {TOOLBELT}/tools/spiral-book && poetry install --no-root   (or: toolbelt setup spiral-book) — without it build skips imposition

checks.label: pypdf importable from the in-project venv (imposition)
skill linked into ~/.claude/skills
checks.fix: toolbelt setup spiral-book — links ~/.claude/skills/spiral-book to this tool's skill/ dir

smoke_test.command: node spiral-book.mjs check && node spiral-book.mjs scaffold "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/spiral-book-smoke-$$" --title Smoke --chapter 01-intro --explain && node --test test/spiral-book.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: check reports pandoc and typst present; the scaffold --explain lists the files it would create and writes none; unit tests green (tiers match the manifest, containment, rendering, scaffold idempotence, the clean gate); the end-to-end test compiles a real PDF where pandoc and typst exist

risk.worst_case: clean --yes deletes the generated .md.typ and PDF files of the one project directory named (all rebuildable by build); scaffold --force replaces that project's template and build files with fresh ones; chapter .md files are never written by either
